Mining Dust Causes Silicosis Deaths in Rajasthan's Aravallis

Dust from mining operations in Rajasthan's Aravalli region is causing a rapid increase in silicosis cases among laborers and local residents. This incurable disease is leading to premature deaths and financial hardship for families. Dainik Jagran reported that the dust is impacting the health of thousands of families, with workers dying young. Outlook India highlighted the human cost of mining, focusing on silicosis, dust, and lives in the Aravallis.
